mapper.insert: INSERT INTO handovers (claim_id, hand_time, place) VALUES (#{claimId}, #{handTime}, #{place})
mapper.select: SELECT h.id, h.claim_id, c.item_id, i.title AS item_title, i.type AS item_type, i.user_id AS owner_id, ou.name AS owner_name, ou.contact AS owner_contact, c.claimant_id, cu.name AS claimant_name, cu.contact AS claimant_contact, h.hand_time, h.place, h.created_at FROM handovers h JOIN claims c ON c.id = h.claim_id JOIN items i ON i.id = c.item_id JOIN users ou ON ou.id = i.user_id JOIN users cu ON cu.id = c.claimant_id WHERE h.id = #{id}
